candidate.rationale: Empirical analysis across all traces shows that when capacity is 2, action 4 or 3 achieves around 80-90 timely correct responses but incurs 10-25 server errors. Action 2 guarantees 0 server errors and yields ~80-84 timely correct responses (outperforming action 1 at ~55-60). However, when capacity is 16, action 8 delivers ~100-106 timely responses without errors, beating action 4 (~95-100) and action 2 (~80-86), while action 16 slows down due to queuing and 1-second SLO budget limits. Therefore, detecting capacity congestion via server_errors > 0 or elevated p90 dispatch latencies allows rapid switching between action 2 (when constrained) and action 8 (when unconstrained), falling back smoothly to 4 or 2.
